verdict.rationale: Structured Streaming (with Auto Loader) is documented as a first-party streaming ingestion API that lets data land incrementally and be queried using the same SQL/DataFrame API as batch, with claimed latency 'as low as five milliseconds' for real-time workloads. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks confirming true seconds-level end-to-end write-to-query latency in production, and more detail on how streaming tables become queryable (e.g., checkpointing/commit visibility) beyond marketing claims.
